rune.beyondsolo.tip.sealed: The skill inside shows itself when the seal breaks.
rune.beyondsolo.tip.use: Hold use to absorb it. A skill you already know rises %s levels.
rune.beyondsolo.tip.engraving: Carves itself into one of your active skills, for good.
rune.beyondsolo.refuse.asleep: The stone stays cold. Only an awakened hunter can absorb a rune.
rune.beyondsolo.refuse.rank: The rune is too strong for you yet: rank %s needed.
rune.beyondsolo.refuse.class: The rune will not answer you: it is for a %s.
rune.beyondsolo.refuse.nothing: The seal holds nothing left for you.
rune.beyondsolo.notify.raised.title: Rune absorbed
rune.beyondsolo.notify.engraved.title: Skill engraved
rune.beyondsolo.notify.engraved.body: The rune of %1$s is carved into %2$s: %3$s
rune.beyondsolo.notify.engraved.replaced: The rune of %1$s is carved into %2$s: %3$s. %4$s was worn away.
rune.beyondsolo.engrave.title: ENGRAVE A SKILL
rune.beyondsolo.engrave.hint: One engraving per skill. A new one wears the old away.
rune.beyondsolo.engrave.none: You know no active skill to carve it into.
rune.beyondsolo.engrave.passive: Only active skills take an engraving.
skill.beyondsolo.hunters_howl.flavour: The Gloomfang's call. The pack answers; the prey freezes.
skill.beyondsolo.hunters_howl.desc: Howl: you and allies within 10 blocks run faster and hit harder for %s seconds, and monsters within 7 blocks are slowed and marked.
skill.beyondsolo.skittering_brood.flavou: A Broodling's last gift: a nest that never stops hatching.
skill.beyondsolo.skittering_brood.desc: Loose a brood of spectral spiderlings ahead of you. Each monster they reach takes %s damage and is poisoned, then %s more from bites each second for 3 seconds.
skill.beyondsolo.crystal_carapace.flavou: A Shardback's crystal, grown under your skin.
skill.beyondsolo.crystal_carapace.desc: +%s armour and some knockback resistance. A monster that strikes you in melee has a %s%% chance to take a shard for %s damage.
skill.beyondsolo.hollow_lance.flavour: The Hollow Acolytes' rite: what it takes from them, it gives to you.
skill.beyondsolo.hollow_lance.desc: Hurl a lance of hollow light up to 16 blocks. Every monster it passes through takes %s magic damage and is weakened, and gives you %s mana back.
skill.beyondsolo.ashen_bulwark.flavour: The Ashen Sentinel's tower shield, raised from the ground.
skill.beyondsolo.ashen_bulwark.desc: For %s seconds, blows from the front deal %s%% less damage and %s%% of a melee blow is thrown back. Nothing knocks you back.
skill.beyondsolo.cinder_wisp.desc: Throw a burning wisp in an arc up to 18 blocks. It bursts where it lands for %s damage and sets everything near it on fire.
skill.beyondsolo.titans_fall.flavour: The Brute never stayed down. Neither does the ground it hits.
skill.beyondsolo.titans_fall.desc: Leap up to 12 blocks and land like the Brute: %s damage and a launch to monsters near the landing, and the ground keeps quaking for 3 seconds.
skill.beyondsolo.widows_snare.flavour: The Broodmother's web. Nothing it catches leaves.
skill.beyondsolo.widows_snare.desc: Cast a web over the ground up to 16 blocks away. Monsters caught in it are held fast for %s seconds, poisoned and bitten for %s each second.
skill.beyondsolo.dread_presence.flavour: The Alpha's killing intent, now yours to let loose.
skill.beyondsolo.dread_presence.desc: For %s seconds, monsters within 12 blocks are weakened and slowed and the lesser ones freeze in terror. You take less damage.
skill.beyondsolo.phantom_flurry.flavour: The Fallen Knight's last duel, fought again in a heartbeat.
skill.beyondsolo.phantom_flurry.desc: Blink to the monster in your sights (12 blocks) and cut it %s times, %s damage each. The last cut throws it back.
skill.beyondsolo.sigil_cascade.flavour: The Magus's spell: a sigil for every foe in sight.
skill.beyondsolo.sigil_cascade.desc: Sigils burn under up to %s of the nearest monsters you can see and burst a moment later for %s magic damage each.
skill.beyondsolo.wyrmfire_roar.flavour: The Wyrm's voice, and its fire with it.
skill.beyondsolo.wyrmfire_roar.desc: Roar a cone of flame 10 blocks ahead for %s damage that sets monsters ablaze. Everything within 16 blocks freezes in terror, and you are kept from burning.
skill.beyondsolo.quickened_pulse.flavour: A rune from the deepest gates. Your heart beats faster than it should.
skill.beyondsolo.iron_resolve.flavour: A rune from the deepest gates. It holds when nothing else does.
skill.beyondsolo.iron_resolve.desc: Below 30%% health, you take %s%% less damage.
